name: AppFactory Project Automation
tagline: A reusable GitHub Action and versioned workflows for Project lifecycle, backlog imports, governance and scoped release/CI utilities.
problem: Teams lose status accuracy when issue metadata, PR reviews and GitHub Projects are managed separately, or when ad-hoc automation is copied per repository.
scenario: A product owner configures project metadata, adopts a pinned reusable workflow and authorizes the broker once. Issue and PR events reconcile board state without leaving a long-lived personal access token in each repository.
differentiation: Convergent project reconciliation plus optional immutable OIDC-broker authorization make automation reusable without sharing business-specific phases or secrets between repos.
architecture: Consumer GitHub events -> reviewed reusable workflow + OIDC broker -> GitHub Projects field/issue reconciliation; independent opt-in governance, impact-aware CI and release workflows.
limitations: A successful workflow run does not by itself prove board field changes when a job was skipped; broker authorization, configured scopes and repository ownership still determine live behavior.
